AI Agent — text-only WebPC adaptation of the user's local voice-agent project.

Runtime vendor files are unchanged upstream releases except the documented ESM wrapper and WASM split below. No model weights are shipped in the website: the selected pinned revision downloads from Hugging Face only after Load model. Inference is local; the web tools make separate explicit task requests.

Transformers.js 4.3.2, Hugging Face, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/releases/tag/4.3.2
The original transformers.min.js exactly matches npm @huggingface/transformers@4.3.2 dist/transformers.min.js. It bundles ONNX Runtime Web and its dependencies; see ONNX Runtime third-party notices.

ONNX Runtime Web 1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0, Microsoft, MIT.
https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web/v/1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0
The local asyncify MJS matches the npm release. Its WASM is split at byte 14000000 into parta/partb and reassembled without modification. This exact development build matches the original Transformers.js runtime; do not upgrade either independently.

Mozilla Readability 0.6.0, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/mozilla/readability/tree/0.6.0
Readability.js is unchanged except its CommonJS export footer is replaced with `export { Readability };` and an attribution comment is added.

idb-keyval 6.2.1, Jake Archibald, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/jakearchibald/idb-keyval/tree/v6.2.1
npm dist/index.js, unchanged except an attribution comment.

Anthropic TypeScript SDK 1.11.0 (bundled), Anthropic, Apache-2.0.
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@anthropic-ai/sdk/v/1.11.0
vendor/anthropic-sdk.mjs is an esbuild 0.27.7 browser bundle (minified, production) of the pinned npm package, rebuilt by scripts/pc/prepare-ai-agent.mjs and verified by SHA-256. It exports only Anthropic and the typed error classes the app uses. It is used only after the user's explicit per-session cloud opt-in; the API key never leaves memory except in requests to the chosen provider.

Embedding model: Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, Xenova (Hugging Face), Apache-2.0 (model card metadata: license: apache-2.0; base model sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2).
https://huggingface.co/Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
Pinned to immutable revision 751bff37182d3f1213fa05d7196b954e230abad9 (onnx/model_quantized.onnx, q8, about 23 MB). The weights are not shipped in the website: they download from Hugging Face only when the user clicks "Build search index", into the browser cache. The Apache-2.0 license text below is the standard license; the model card declares Apache-2.0. The embedding index is memory only and never leaves the device.

Model repositories and immutable revisions: models.js.
Qwen3.5-0.8B ONNX OPT: Apache-2.0 in the pinned conversion repository.
Qwen3.5-2B ONNX OPT: upstream Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B is Apache-2.0; the conversion repository does not supply its own license metadata. Weights are not redistributed here.
LFM3-1.7B ONNX: LFM Open License v1.0, not Apache/MIT. Review the actual license for applicable conditions, including the commercial-license requirement for entities above its revenue threshold. No claim of unrestricted commercial use is made.

License texts are in licenses/. Browser cached model files retain their own terms.
No vendor fonts from the original voice app are retained; the standalone UI uses system fonts.

License provenance: ONNX Runtime MIT and third-party notice texts were retrieved from the published v1.24.2 source tag via cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/microsoft/onnxruntime@v1.24.2/ (the dev-build commit URL returned 404). The pinned dev npm archive supplies no notice files. These notices are retained conservatively; they are not an assertion that the dev build's complete transitive dependency inventory matches v1.24.2. The upstream minified bundle is retained byte-for-byte.

Additional license copies cover declared JS dependencies: @huggingface/jinja (MIT), @huggingface/tokenizers (Apache-2.0), long (Apache-2.0), platform (MIT), protobufjs (BSD-3-Clause), flatbuffers (Apache-2.0). The copied version labels are the minimum package ranges declared by the pinned upstream packages, not a reconstruction of their unreleased build lockfiles. onnxruntime-common is MIT (Microsoft); guid-typescript declares ISC and ships no license file in its npm package. See the upstream declarations recorded in dependency-metadata.json.
